name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: Enterprise collaboration platform (Lark) with messaging, calendar, docs and video, exposed via OpenAPIs.
auth_notes: App ID and App Secret issue a tenant_access_token (app identity) or user_access_token (user identity); tokens are sent in HTTP headers. The international domain is open.larksuite.com; Feishu (CN) uses different domains.
access_notes: Custom apps are created in the Developer Console and issue App ID and App Secret. Store apps are limited to ISV-qualified users. API scopes require enterprise administrator approval. Pricing is not stated in the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve custom app credentials and documented OAuth-based OpenAPIs, but each API scope needs enterprise administrator approval per customer. Pricing is not stated in the fetched pages.

identity.quote: Lark is an advanced enterprise collaboration and management platform that integrates instant messaging, calendar, cloud documents

access.quote: Only ISV-qualified users can create store apps.

api_surface.quote: Traditional webhook mode, requiring you to provide a public internet address for receiving event messages.

buildability.quote: only after the enterprise administrator approves can the application proceed with subsequent API calls or event listening.

needs_human_reason: Pricing and plan-tier API access are not in the fetched pages. The API style is recorded as other because the pages say OpenAPI and HTTP but not REST. The lark-mcp npm page returned 403, so the MCP url is left null. Feishu (CN) is a separate platform and was not checked.
